methodologicalNovelty: Represent each rolling pre-draw number co-occurrence structure as a weighted graph/metric filtration and extract topological persistence summaries (connected-component and cycle persistence) for candidate ranking. This is distinct from frequency, pairwise Ising/MaxEnt, spectral, kernel, Hawkes and ordinary graph-centrality families because selection is driven by filtration-stable topological features rather than raw edge weights or eigenvectors.

guard.whyDistinct: No repository implementation was found for persistence diagrams, Betti/persistent-homology summaries or simplicial filtrations.
